newsitem.title: UK: NatWest had merger talks with Pru - paper.
newsitem.headline: NatWest had merger talks with Pru - paper.

text.p: Britain's National Westminster Bank Plc has held merger talks with insurance and financial services group Prudential Corp Plc, said the Sunday Telegraph newspaper.
It said on Sunday that sources inside both groups confirmed that NatWest and Prudential had held "conversations" but noted than an imminent deal is not expected.
The newspaper said that a source at NatWest did not know whether the talks would be resumed.
Other newspapers noted speculation that newly-floated banking group Halifax Plc was being lined up as a potential partner for NatWest.
NatWest recently failed in an attempt to make British banking rival Barclays Plc come clean on whether it was plotting a takeover bid.
Britain's Takeover Panel, which polices City takeovers, rejected a call by NatWest for Barclays to clarify its position.
